flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.
Above 1,700 m: in Region 3 no motor vehicles except snowmobiles, except on existing roads and trails (synopsis page 33, 99%). Elevation from terrain tiles (estimate).

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1; spike fork bulls: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)

plan: Drive: from Heffley Creek, about 143 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, Lloyd Rd, Martin Creek FSR, Hole In The Wall FSR.
Park: 51.76893, -119.65504, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 1.6 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 363 m, about 69 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-40, Region 3. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 20 to Oct 31 (synopsis page 34, 99%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
